snippet.title: Dicealot Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
Dicealot is a Arthurian-inspired roguelike diebuilder. Play fantastical Farkle hands to earn magical Quest-Dice and complete your quest.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035330/Dicealot/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!

Six One Indie is a grassroots collective focused on making gaming showcases, awards, and overall visibility more approachable for independent developers.
